lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
lines.translation: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano pa(n)dit paRan rakheesur jug jug vedaa naale ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh paiaale ||
lines.translation: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere athasath teerath naale ||
lines.translation: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare ||
lines.translation: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano kha(n)d ma(n)dal brahama(n)daa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
lines.translation: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
lines.translation: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
lines.translation: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee ||
lines.translation: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee ||
lines.translation: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maaiaa jin upaaee ||
lines.translation: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar dekhai keetaa aapanaa jiu tis dee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee phir hukam na karanaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rahan rajaaee ||1||
lines.translation: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||
Aasaa, First Mehl:
Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.
But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.
His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.
Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vade mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
lines.translation: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na jaanai teraa ketaa kevad cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||
All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.
All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.
The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaaee teree til vadiaaee ||2||
lines.translation: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,
all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paaeeaa ||
lines.translation: without You, no one has attained such powers.
They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||
What can the poor helpless creatures do?
Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?
O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||
Aasaa, First Mehl:
Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||
How can I forget Him, O my mother?
True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||
Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,
people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je sabh mil kai aakhan paahi ||
lines.translation: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa na hovai ghaat na jaai ||2||
lines.translation: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ohu marai na hovai sog ||
lines.translation: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.
He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.
This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
lines.translation: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||
As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.
